concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-add-manage-funds-process-payments-make-a-payment]] — 2026-09-15 Issuing guide for online/Terminal API payments from customers whose revenue can fund issued cards; distinguishes channel-specific setup and amount units, and flags unlabeled split data in its example.
warnings: Requirements says any of Transfer or Transaction webhook subscriptions, but final Webhooks section says both; the guide gives no single unambiguous minimum.

In-person example titles claim split instructions/success, but the shown request contains no split allocation details and its EUR 200.00 request does not match the response's USD 8000 AdditionalResponse values; do not infer a configured split, recipient balance account or verified payment.
